Subject: Invoice delivery + issuer question for new subscription (PO12345)

Hi Soojin / Kimberly,

We're getting ready to process the PO for the new subscription (PO12345). Before we get the first invoice, can you confirm the following so AP can map the invoice correctly?

- Which legal entity will issue the invoice (Redwood Inference UK Ltd vs Redwood Inference, Inc)?
- Can you provide the VAT ID that will appear on the invoice? We need it for EU reverse-charge treatment.
- Delivery method: our AP prefers UBL (UBL 2.1) pushed to our SFTP endpoint, with a PDF copy emailed to accounts.payable@greenline.com. If you can't do UBL immediately, we can accept a temporary PDF-only workflow but will need UBL for recurring processing.
- AP requires the BuyerRemitID field set and the PO number in the invoice header.

I've attached our VAT certificate for your records. If you can confirm issuer and planned delivery method, we can share SFTP details and the AP contact.

Thanks,
Marc
Accounts Payable / Greenline Therapeutics
Attachments: Greenline_VAT_cert.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Invoice delivery + issuer question for new subscription (PO12345)

Thanks Marc — good questions. Quick summary and proposal from our side:

1) Issuer: proposal is Redwood Inference UK Ltd for this contract so the invoice will show the UK VAT ID. That aligns with the customer's EU entity and simplifies reverse-charge treatment.
2) VAT: we'll include our UK VAT number on the invoice and add a line stating "Reverse charge — Article 196 (intra-community supply)" per EU guidance. If Greenline prefers a different wording, please flag.
3) Delivery: we can deliver a PDF to accounts.payable@greenline.com for the first invoice while we stand up UBL over SFTP. We will also provide a UBL sample file to your AP team and aim to complete SFTP onboarding within 3 business days.

I've attached a UBL sample (sample_ubl.xml) and our internal note on EU VAT invoicing to show field mappings. Action items:
- Marc: confirm Greenwood (sic) - sorry, Greenline - accepts temporary PDF-only arrival for first invoice and that the BuyerRemitID and PO location are the correct mapping points.
- Connor: will prepare the UBL sample and SFTP account.
- Kimberly: please approve issuing from Redwood Inference UK Ltd (I think this is fine, but want manager sign-off for legal).

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: sample_ubl.xml (xml), redwood_eu_vat_guidance.docx (docx)
